nodes.description: ERC20 private mapping (address => uint256) tracking token balances; mutated by _transfer and _mint.
ERC20 private nested mapping (address => mapping(address => uint256)) storing spending allowances.
ERC20 private uint256 total token supply; increased by _mint.
External function in MintToken that loops over recipients/values arrays and performs _transfer for each entry from the caller.
MintToken constructor that mints 250,000,000 * 10**18 tokens to the deployer via _mint(_msgSender(), ...).
Internal ERC20 transfer routine that validates addresses and rewrites _balances[sender] and _balances[recipient].
Internal ERC20 minting routine that increases _totalSupply and credits _balances[account].
Internal ERC20 approval routine that writes _allowances[owner][spender].
msg.sender inside transferMany: caller-controlled address used as the source of every _transfer in the loop.
msg.sender inside the MintToken constructor: deployer address receiving the initial 250M token mint.
Unbounded for-loop in transferMany invoking the state-mutating _transfer for every element of caller-supplied arrays without a reentrancy guard or length cap.
calldata address[] recipients supplied by the caller of transferMany.
calldata uint256[] values supplied by the caller of transferMany, used as the transferred amounts.
uint256 loop index of the for-loop inside transferMany.

edges.reason: msg.sender identifies the caller whose identity governs execution of transferMany.
The recipients calldata array defines the transfer targets consumed by transferMany.
The values calldata array defines the transfer amounts consumed by transferMany.
Loop index i controls iteration count of transferMany's for-loop against recipients.length.
transferMany enters the unsafe unbounded loop that performs repeated _transfer calls.
msg.sender is passed as the sender argument of every loop-invoked _transfer, so a single caller drives repeated state-changing transfers without a reentrancy guard.
recipients[i] flows into the unsafe loop as the recipient argument of _transfer.
values[i] flows into the unsafe loop as the amount argument of _transfer.
Each loop iteration of the unsafe operation invokes the internal _transfer routine.
_transfer subtracts from _balances[sender] and adds to _balances[recipient], mutating stored balances.
msg.sender is the beneficiary address passed to _mint by the MintToken constructor.
The constructor calls _mint to create the initial token supply.
_mint increases _totalSupply via SafeMath add, so the total supply depends on the minted amount.
_mint credits _balances[account] through SafeMath add for the minted amount.

normalization_plan.reason: The recipients calldata array is only meaningful inside transferMany and should be folded into that core function node.
The values calldata array is only consumed inside transferMany and should be folded into that core function node.
The loop index i exists solely to drive the unbounded _transfer loop and should be merged into that unsafe operation node.
